annotations.title: List the by-laws of a South African municipality

description: The municipal by-laws and land use schemes GetLawED holds for a South African place, optionally for one topic — each with its status (in force / amended / repealed), promulgation date, gazette reference, official source link and doc_id for legal_get_section. Repealed by-laws are left out unless asked for.

place.description: Town, suburb or municipality name, or a municipal code (e.g. "WC043")

topic.description: Only one topic: planning (land use, zoning, rezoning), building (building, signage, fencing), finance (rates, tariffs, credit control), utilities (water, sanitation, electricity), waste, roads_traffic, public_spaces (amenities, nuisances, noise), business (trading, liquor, guest houses), health_environment, animals, safety (fire, events, land invasion), governance, other

name: bylaws_for_place
title: List the by-laws of a South African municipality
